name: Bedrock Guardrails Disabled
summary: Detects Bedrock model invocations without guardrails enabled.
rationale: Without guardrails, model outputs are not content-filtered, risking harmful, unsafe, or non-compliant responses.
remediation: Set guardrailEnabled: true in the Bedrock configuration.

name: CloudFront Weak SSL Protocol
summary: Detects CloudFront distributions configured to allow SSL/TLS protocols older than TLSv1.2.
rationale: Older TLS protocols have known cryptographic vulnerabilities that can be exploited to intercept or downgrade connections.
remediation: Set minimumProtocolVersion to TLSv1.2_2021 or higher.

name: ECR Image Scan Disabled
summary: Detects ECR repositories that do not scan images on push.
rationale: Without scan-on-push, vulnerable container images can be deployed undetected, propagating known CVEs into production.
remediation: Set scanOnPush: true in the ECR repository configuration.

name: EKS Addon Version Unset
summary: Detects EKS addons that do not pin a specific version.
rationale: Unpinned addon versions can be upgraded unexpectedly, introducing compatibility issues or unreviewed changes.
remediation: Set addonVersion to a specific version string.

name: Lambda Timeout Excessive
summary: Detects Lambda functions configured with a timeout exceeding 900 seconds.
rationale: Excessive timeouts often indicate an architectural anti-pattern and can mask hung executions that consume resources and cost.
remediation: Reduce the Lambda timeout to 900 seconds or less, or use Step Functions for long-running workflows.

name: Athena Workgroup Bytes Limit Missing
summary: Detects Athena workgroups that lack a bytes-scanned cutoff per query.
rationale: Without a scan limit, a single runaway query can scan enormous amounts of data and incur unexpectedly large costs.
remediation: Set bytesScannedCutoffPerQuery in the Athena workgroup configuration.

name: Budget Threshold Missing
summary: Detects AWS Budgets with no notification threshold or SNS topic configured.
rationale: Without a threshold and alert topic, cost overruns go unnoticed until the bill arrives, preventing timely corrective action.
remediation: Set thresholdPercentage and notificationTopicArn in the budget configuration.

name: S3 Public Access Not Blocked
summary: Detects S3 buckets used as CloudFront origins that rely on public access instead of Origin Access Control.
rationale: Publicly accessible origin buckets expose data directly, bypassing CloudFront access controls and risking data leakage.
remediation: Use CloudFront Origin Access Control (OAC) instead of public S3 bucket access.

name: SageMaker VPC Disabled
summary: Detects SageMaker models that are not deployed within a VPC.
rationale: Running models outside a VPC removes network isolation, exposing the model and its data to public network risks.
remediation: Configure vpcConfig with subnetIds and securityGroupIds.

name: Athena Workgroup Encryption Disabled
summary: Detects Athena workgroups that do not encrypt query results at rest.
rationale: Unencrypted query results stored in S3 expose potentially sensitive data to anyone with bucket access.
remediation: Set encryptionOption to SSE_S3 or SSE_KMS in the Athena workgroup configuration.

name: ElastiCache Encryption Disabled
summary: Detects ElastiCache Redis replication groups missing at-rest or in-transit encryption.
rationale: Unencrypted cache data can be read at rest or intercepted in transit, exposing sensitive cached information.
remediation: Set atRestEncryptionEnabled: true and transitEncryptionEnabled: true.

name: Firehose Encryption Disabled
summary: Detects Kinesis Firehose delivery streams without server-side encryption.
rationale: Unencrypted delivery streams expose streamed data, risking interception of sensitive records in transit.
remediation: Set encryptionEnabled: true in the Firehose configuration.

name: Glue Job Security Config Missing
summary: Detects AWS Glue jobs that have no security configuration for encryption.
rationale: Without a security configuration, Glue job data and logs are not encrypted at rest or in transit, exposing sensitive ETL data.
remediation: Set securityConfiguration in the Glue job configuration.

name: KMS Key Rotation Disabled
summary: Detects symmetric KMS keys that do not have automatic key rotation enabled.
rationale: Rotation limits the volume of data encrypted under any single key version, reducing the blast radius of a compromised key.
remediation: Set enableKeyRotation: true for symmetric KMS keys.

name: MSK Encryption In Transit Disabled
summary: Detects MSK clusters that do not enforce TLS for client-broker communication.
rationale: Plaintext client-broker traffic can be intercepted, exposing streamed message data in transit.
remediation: Set encryptionInTransit to 'TLS' in the MSK cluster configuration.

name: OpenSearch Encryption Disabled
summary: Detects OpenSearch domains missing at-rest or node-to-node encryption.
rationale: Unencrypted OpenSearch data can be read at rest or intercepted between nodes, exposing indexed sensitive data.
remediation: Set encryptionAtRest: true and nodeToNodeEncryption: true.

name: RDS Encryption Disabled
summary: Detects Aurora/RDS clusters without storage encryption enabled.
rationale: Unencrypted database storage exposes data at rest if underlying volumes or snapshots are accessed.
remediation: Set storageEncrypted: true in the RDS cluster configuration.

name: Admin Access Review
summary: Flags IAM intents that grant admin-level actions for justification review.
rationale: Admin access grants full control over a resource, violating least privilege and increasing the impact of a compromised principal (KL-005).
remediation: Use a 'read' or 'write' access level instead of admin where full control is not required.

name: ElastiCache Auth Disabled
summary: Detects ElastiCache Redis replication groups that do not require an AUTH token.
rationale: Without an AUTH token, any client with network access can connect to the cache, risking unauthorized data access.
remediation: Set transitEncryptionEnabled: true and provide an authToken.

name: MSK Authentication Disabled
summary: Detects MSK clusters with no client authentication configured.
rationale: Without client authentication, any client with network reach can produce or consume from Kafka topics, risking unauthorized access.
remediation: Configure clientAuthentication with SASL-IAM, SASL-SCRAM, or TLS.

name: Missing IAM Conditions
summary: Detects cross-service IAM grants that lack scoping conditions.
rationale: Unconditioned cross-service grants are broader than necessary, increasing the risk of lateral movement and privilege misuse.
remediation: Add conditions to the IAM grant to scope cross-service access.

name: No Wildcard Resources
summary: Detects IAM intents that use pattern-scoped (wildcard) resources.
rationale: Wildcard resource scopes grant access far beyond what is needed, violating least privilege by construction (KL-005).
remediation: Use scope 'specific' with explicit resource references instead of pattern scopes.

name: Secrets Rotation Disabled
summary: Detects SecretsManager secrets without automatic rotation enabled.
rationale: Static, long-lived secrets increase the window of exposure if credentials are leaked or compromised.
remediation: Set rotationEnabled: true in the SecretsManager configuration.

name: ALB Access Logs Disabled
summary: Detects Application Load Balancers that do not have access logging enabled.
rationale: Without access logs, request-level auditing and troubleshooting of traffic to the load balancer is not possible.
remediation: Enable access logging on the ALB with an S3 bucket destination.

name: CloudTrail Log Validation Disabled
summary: Detects CloudTrail trails without log file integrity validation enabled.
rationale: Without log file validation, tampering with audit logs cannot be detected, undermining forensic and compliance evidence.
remediation: Set enableLogFileValidation: true in the CloudTrail configuration.

name: EKS Logging Disabled
summary: Detects EKS clusters that do not enable control plane logging.
rationale: Without API, audit, and authenticator logs, security events on the Kubernetes control plane cannot be monitored or investigated.
remediation: Enable API, audit, and authenticator log types on the EKS cluster.

name: GuardDuty Not Enabled
summary: Detects accounts/configurations where GuardDuty threat detection is not enabled.
rationale: Without GuardDuty, continuous threat detection and anomaly monitoring across the account is absent, delaying breach detection.
remediation: Set enabled: true in the GuardDuty detector configuration.

name: Network Firewall Logging Disabled
summary: Detects AWS Network Firewall instances without logging enabled.
rationale: Without firewall logs, malicious traffic and policy violations go unrecorded, impeding security monitoring and forensics.
remediation: Set loggingEnabled: true in the Network Firewall configuration.

name: Step Functions Logging Disabled
summary: Detects Step Functions state machines with CloudWatch logging disabled.
rationale: Without execution logging, failures and state transitions cannot be debugged or audited.
remediation: Add logging: true to the Step Functions configuration.

name: Telemetry Tracing Disabled
summary: Detects compute resources without X-Ray tracing enabled.
rationale: Without distributed tracing, observability into request flows and performance bottlenecks is lost, slowing incident response.
remediation: Add tracing: true to the Lambda function configuration.

name: Broad Network Protocol
summary: Detects network intents that use the overly permissive protocol 'any'.
rationale: Allowing all protocols broadens the network attack surface beyond what the workload requires.
remediation: Specify the protocol as 'tcp' or 'udp' instead of 'any'.

name: ECS Task Public IP
summary: Detects Fargate tasks configured to assign a public IP address.
rationale: Public IPs on tasks expand the attack surface by exposing workloads directly to the internet instead of routing through controlled egress.
remediation: Set assignPublicIp to false (DISABLED) in the ECS service configuration.

name: EKS Endpoint Public Access
summary: Detects EKS clusters exposing the Kubernetes API endpoint publicly.
rationale: A public API endpoint exposes the cluster control plane to the internet, increasing the risk of unauthorized access attempts.
remediation: Disable public endpoint access and use a VPN or bastion host for cluster management.

name: OpenSearch Public Access
summary: Detects OpenSearch domains or serverless collections that are publicly accessible.
rationale: Public OpenSearch access exposes indexed data directly to the internet, risking data exfiltration.
remediation: Set publicAccess: false and configure VPC endpoints.

name: RDS Public Access
summary: Detects RDS clusters that are configured as publicly accessible.
rationale: Publicly accessible databases are exposed to the internet, dramatically increasing the risk of unauthorized access and data breach.
remediation: Set publicAccess: false and use RDS Proxy for application connections.

name: Transit Gateway Auto Accept Enabled
summary: Detects transit gateways that auto-accept shared attachments.
rationale: Auto-accepting attachments allows unvetted VPCs to connect, risking unauthorized network peering and lateral movement.
remediation: Set autoAcceptSharedAttachments to 'disable'.

name: WAF Not Attached
summary: Detects public-facing CloudFront distributions with no WAF Web ACL attached.
rationale: Without a WAF, public distributions lack protection against common web exploits such as injection and bot traffic.
remediation: Add a WAF v2 Web ACL and associate it with the CloudFront distribution.

name: EKS GPU Spot Capacity
summary: Detects GPU node groups using SPOT capacity for production workloads.
rationale: SPOT GPU instances can be reclaimed at any time, interrupting training or inference jobs and causing workload failures.
remediation: Set capacityType to 'ON_DEMAND' for production GPU node groups.

name: EventBridge Retry Missing
summary: Detects EventBridge Scheduler schedules with no retry policy configured.
rationale: Without retries, transient failures cause schedules to silently drop invocations, leading to missed or lost executions.
remediation: Add a retryPolicy with maximumRetryAttempts to the schedule configuration.

name: Route53 Health Check Missing
summary: Detects public Route53 hosted zones with no health checks configured.
rationale: Without health checks, DNS cannot fail over away from unhealthy endpoints, reducing availability during outages.
remediation: Add a healthCheck configuration to the Route53 zone.

name: SQS DLQ Missing
summary: Detects SQS queues that have no dead letter queue configured.
rationale: Without a DLQ, repeatedly failing messages are eventually discarded, causing silent data loss.
remediation: Add deadLetterQueue: true to the SQS queue configuration.

name: SageMaker Pipeline Parallelism Missing
summary: Detects SageMaker pipelines without parallelism configuration.
rationale: Unbounded parallelism can exhaust resources during pipeline execution, causing failures or unpredictable resource consumption.
remediation: Set parallelismConfiguration with maxParallelExecutionSteps.

name: Step Functions Max Recursion Exceeded
summary: Detects Step Functions state machines with an excessive recursion depth.
rationale: Deep recursion risks infinite loops and resource exhaustion, potentially causing runaway executions and cost.
remediation: Reduce maxRecursionDepth to 50 or less, or refactor into separate state machines with dynamic parallelism.
